title: Scientific Work Unit specification

canonical_definition.purpose: make scientific/research workloads first-class while keeping the market general-purpose

canonical_sources.researchProjectCommitment: required immutable commitment; authoritative registry deferred to CMP-4.2
canonical_sources.executableContainerCommitment: accepted CMP-0.4 signed manifest executable/container/runtime semantics
canonical_sources.verificationStrategyCommitment: frozen ComputeJobRegistry420 verificationPolicyCommitment; CMP-1.4.8 route where applicable
canonical_sources.deadline: effective accepted execution deadline, never later than canonical job/request deadline

authority_boundaries: scientific binding creates no lifecycle, requester, payer, worker, verifier, scheduler, Vault, settlement, stake/slash, governance, bridge, wallet or validator authority
scientific commitment is not correctness evidence, payment entitlement or reward authorization
fundingRef must come from canonical funded-job evidence and cannot be self-reported
dataset/input commitment does not grant data-access authority
verification strategy is frozen before execution and cannot be worker-selected after result
executable/container commitment does not weaken CMP-3 sandbox, content-addressing, malicious-workload or resource-control requirements
exit_criteria: all nine canonical roadmap bindings are explicit
commitment is domain-separated, versioned, chain-bound and unit-bound
all duplicate fields map to one canonical source of truth
scientific metadata cannot become alternate authority
CMP-1.4.8 scientific verification remains distinct and compatible
machine-readable config and mechanical verifier/test are committed
affected Compute Market Level 1 workflow passes exact implementation SHA
